newsitem.title: TURKEY: Iraqi Kurd leader Talabani due in Turkey.
newsitem.headline: Iraqi Kurd leader Talabani due in Turkey.

text.p: Iraqi Kurdish leader Jalal Talabani is expected in Turkey this week for talks with a senior U.S. diplomat and Turkish officials, a Turkish foreign ministry official said on Monday.

"Talabani will probably be in Turkey tomorrow," the official told Reuters. He said Talabani, who heads the Patriotic Union of Kurdistan (PUK), would meet Washington's northern Iraq envoy Robert Pelletreau in the Turkish capital.
The official said Talabani's rival, Kurdistan Democratic Party (KDP) head Massoud Barzani, had also been invited to Ankara but that it was not known if he would come.
The two groups are set to hold a further round of peace talks in Ankara following a U.S.-brokered ceasefire in October.
Barzani's forces joined with Iraqi troops to take the key Kurdish city of Arbil from Talabani's fighters in August, prompting retaliatory U.S. missile strikes on Iraqi targets.
The clashes gave Baghdad a foothold in the Western-protected north of Iraq.
